creators.name: Md Zahurul Haque
creators.affiliation: Dept. of CSE, Manarat International University, Dhaka, Bangladesh

title: AutoDocker: reproducible, containerized virtual screening with AutoDock Vina
description: AutoDocker is a containerized virtual-screening pipeline that prepares proteins (chain selection, fpocket pocket detection, receptor PDBQT), prepares ligands (local SDF/MOL2/PDB/PDBQT files or PubChem downloads), docks with AutoDock Vina (with QuickVina 2 and SMINA options), and produces reproducible ranked reports (ranking.csv, Top_hits.txt, metrics.txt, and an optional HTML report with an embedded NGL 3D viewer).
